games.name: [CHURCH] Anomaly Watch
games.desc:
Anomaly Watch is a horror game inspired by the Mandela Catalogue and the I'm On Observation Duty games. In Anomaly Watch you are sent to explore a rural house where unexplainable events happen, objects go missing, become distorted, and strange humanoids appear. Your job is to recognize and report unexplainable events and most importantly, report unrecognizable creatures and intruders. All in all survive until 6 am. Good Luck!

House Keybinds:
PC: Equip Tablet - R
Mobile: Equip Tablet - Button on side of the screen.

Office Keybinds:
Flashlight: F or Gamepad B
Sprint: Left Shift or Gamepad R1
Exiting the reporter: Jump

Horror outside human comprehension.
Thank you for playing Anomaly Watch

Developer: punitto

don't let her in 🏠[HORROR]
games.desc:
Comment on our group wall with any bugs you encounter!

Waking up in the middle of the night to coldness, you are tasked with warming up the furnace to keep you and your baby warm. Though, after doing so your ex-wife starts to knock on your door and demands to take the baby. So after slamming the door in her face, she goes crazy and tries to break in.

 Your main task is to not let her in and survive until 7am
 This game is a lot easier with friends

Tips:
- If you are on mobile turn up your brightness
- If you don't wind up the music box, the mom will try to break in a lot more
- You can only keep 2 lights on at once so make sure to constantly rotate through them
- Watch the windows to catch the ex-wife trying to break in

[ CONTROLS ]
L2/Shift to sprint
